Great idea, poorly executed. Fun to play when it works, there is not 1 day where I log in and the game doesn't crash, disconnect me from a lobby randomly, or I flop so hard from an explosion that I get stuck in the ground. Man, peace.

After the recent Halo update, you can expect somewhere between 5~15% of crash rate.

The game either go straight frozen, turning your CPU 100% occupation and you have to force restart the PC; or freeze for 5~10 seconds, like 3 time a match, then kept going.
Some of my friends also encountered weird bugs like instant death after reinforcement, hitbox glitch that bumps you wayyy out of the map and so on.

But still, the performance issue is the worst, I have to force restart my PC every 10 to 30 games.
And yes, when your game lag/freeze, if you're in fullscreen mode, Task Manager cannot help you as it will be covered by the game screen. Windows/Alt+Tab/Alt+F4, and many other short cuts simply doesn't work.

It's so bad that I have to write a review here since it's literally unplayable.

Edit: For those who doubt if it's my PC issue, this is my video editing PC with i7 13700k+RTX4080+64GB RAM, running ALL OTHER 500+ GAMES just fine.

Don't buy into the hype, this game is straight up bad right now. It has potential, but has some incredibly frustrating elements that are absolutely intentional by the devs. For example, you have a swarm of enemies that slow, stunlock, and ragdoll you, leaving you zero counter play. Fire is instant death, the maps will kill your visibility while the enemy can still see across the map, and some missions flat can't be completed due to enemy spawn rates. You can destroy enemy spawners, which you would think would lessen their numbers, but no, they get MORE. Mission types get stale quick. Frankly, if it didn't have the starship troopers references and the memes, this game would already be on the bargain shelf.

Can't have mods, can't have old weapons matched up, can't have fundamental bugs fixed, can't have basic features that exist in any other game.

But we can still have super credit cheaters and no-clippers. Thanks EAC! We can still have power creep, host desync, detection through cover, and those game-breaking "bugs" regarding the game's actual unique features. Thanks Arrowhead! At least the game is still fun, despite your best efforts!

(Barely) legally distinct copyright infringement on Starship Troopers, with a little Terminator and ODST mixed in. By far the best co-op shooter I've played, probably the best game of the year. The feeling of just sweeping through hordes of bugs with the definitely-not-a-phaser is hard to beat.

Has had its ups and downs, but the devs keep improving it and I keep coming back to it, so that's a thumbs up from me.
P.S. recommended with friends.

I love Helldivers, which is why I cannot in good faith recommend it at the moment. The performance is absolutely abysmal. I cannot go five minutes, let alone an entire mission without: audio issues, freezing/stuttering, and constant damage desync. Enemies like Warstriders, Roaches, and Fleshmobs (leviathans are still disabled) fundamentally go against the concept of having meaningful counterplay; which is such an integral part of enjoying higher difficulties in this game. However, the most egregious sin of Arrowhead is censoring LtBuzzLitebeer and removing him from the creator program. The whole point of having that program was to ensure good game balance and adhere to constructive feedback, was it not? Any other game making all of these mistakes would have died out ages ago! That's how beloved it is to me and many others... I'm holding out hope for the promised performance patch due in a week or two- Though I remain highly skeptical in Arrowhead's ability to truly pave the way going forward and moreover, maintain the game for the duration of its live service.
